001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Collections;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Map;
008import org.clafer.ast.AstAbstractClafer;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.Card;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class AbstractOffsetAnalyzer implements Analyzer {
017
018    @Override
019    public Analysis analyze(final Analysis analysis) {
020        Map<AstAbstractClafer, Offsets> offsetsMap = new HashMap<>();
021        for (AstAbstractClafer abstractClafer : analysis.getAbstractClafers()) {
022            Map<AstClafer, Integer> offsets = new HashMap<>();
023            List<AstClafer> reverseOffsets = new ArrayList<>();
024            int offset = 0;
025            List<AstClafer> subs = new ArrayList<>(abstractClafer.getSubs());
026            /*
027             * What is this optimization?
028             *
029             * This optimization is to put more "stable" Clafers near the
030             * beginning, to reduce the number of backtracking for LowGroups.
031             */
032            Collections.sort(subs, (AstClafer o1, AstClafer o2) -> {
033                Card card1 = analysis.getGlobalCard(o1);
034                Card card2 = analysis.getGlobalCard(o2);
035                double ratio1 = ((double) card1.getLow() + 1) / ((double) card1.getHigh() + 1);
036                double ratio2 = ((double) card2.getLow() + 1) / ((double) card2.getHigh() + 1);
037                return -Double.compare(ratio1, ratio2);
038            });
039            for (AstClafer sub : subs) {
040                offsets.put(sub, offset);
041                int skip = analysis.getScope(sub);
042                for (int i = 0; i < skip; i++) {
043                    reverseOffsets.add(sub);
044                }
045                offset += skip;
046            }
047            offsetsMap.put(abstractClafer, new Offsets(abstractClafer, offsets, reverseOffsets.toArray(new AstClafer[reverseOffsets.size()])));
048        }
049        return analysis.setOffsetMap(offsetsMap);
050    }
051}
